framework_lessons: Compare business quality with entry price.
Separate cyclical stress from structural demand.
assessment: The macro caution held up better than the near-term FedEx profit improvement rationale. Census data validate the e-commerce floor, while later earnings expose substantial operating leverage. The five-year relative stock test has not yet matured; no business-growth observation is counted as proof of shareholder outperformance.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
Audit removed duplicate074-C24: its original two-year EPS horizon was not supported by the text. Coverage retained in074-C25.
